addTuiAgentDescription: Register a CLI tool as a TUI agent. It will appear in the agent list with a default passthrough profile.
agentCliFlagsDescription: Flags passed to the agent CLI on launch. Only enabled entries are applied.
agentInstallAlreadyInProgress: Agent installation is already in progress.
authRequiredOpenLoginTerminal: Authentication required - click to open login terminal
authRequiredOpenShell: Authentication required - click to open a shell and sign in
availableSlashCommandsHelp: Type these during a session chat to invoke them - e.g. <0>{{example}}</0>.
availableToInstallDescription: Click Install to run the agent's install script on the kandev host. Progress streams live; you can start multiple installs in parallel.
capabilityAuthRequired: Authentication required. Run the agent CLI in your terminal to authenticate, then refresh.
capabilityProbeFailed: Probe failed. Check agent logs for details.
changeTierMappingsFirst: Change these workspace tier mappings before deleting this profile.
everythingInstalled: Every available agent and tool is already installed.
commandPrefixHelp: Tokens prepended to the agent launch command, so it runs under a sandbox launcher (e.g. <0>{{example}}</0>). The value is shell-tokenised. Leave empty to run the agent directly. Applies to ACP sessions only; it has no effect when the profile uses TUI passthrough.
commandPreviewHelp: The CLI command that will be executed based on the current settings.
configureProfilesIntro: Configure profiles and defaults for this agent.
disableProfileUtilityWarning: Utility agents use this profile. Disabling it will stop new utility calls until each binding is repaired.
createProfileIntro: Create a new profile for this agent.
deleteAgentDescription: This will permanently remove the agent and all its profiles. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAgentProfileDescription: This will permanently delete this profile. This action cannot be undone.
deleteAnywayConsequences: These sessions will no longer be able to use this profile and the listed watchers will be disabled. This action cannot be undone.
enableMcpDescription: Allow this profile to use MCP servers during sessions.
enabledProfileHelper: Disabled profiles keep serving existing sessions but are not offered when creating new tasks or agents.
everyProfileNeedsNameAndModel: Every profile needs a name and model.
modelOptionsAuthenticationRequired: Sign in to this agent to load model options.
modelOptionsResolutionFailed: Model options could not be loaded.
fixInvalidMcpConfig: Fix invalid MCP configuration before saving.
fixInvalidMcpJson: Fix invalid MCP JSON before saving.
hostTerminalDescription: Runs a shell on the kandev host. Use it to install or configure agents manually.
installedAgentsDescription: Agents detected on this machine are ready to configure.
mcpConfigMustBeJsonObject: MCP servers config must be a JSON object
mcpDraftHint: MCP config will be applied after the profile is saved.
mcpPassthroughInjectionHint: In CLI passthrough mode, kandev injects these MCP servers via {{mechanism}}.
mcpSaveProfileHint: Save this profile to configure MCP servers.
mcpServersHelp: MCP definitions are stored in the database and resolved per executor at runtime. This does not override your local agent config.
mcpStrategyHelp: Kandev can hand this agent its own tools (set task title, ask the user a question, update the plan, mark a step complete). To do that it must write MCP config in the format your CLI reads, so pick the one that matches. Choosing the wrong format fails silently: the config is written, the CLI ignores it, and no error is shown. Leave this off if the command is not an MCP-capable coding agent.
modelRequiredForAllProfiles: Model is required for all profiles.
noAuthHintLogin: Click Open terminal to sign in, then refresh.
noAuthHintNotInstalled: Install the agent CLI, then click Refresh.
noAuthHintShell: Click Open terminal to launch a shell, run the agent's sign-in command, then refresh.
noCliFlagsConfigured: No CLI flags configured. Add one below.
noInstalledAgentsDetected: No installed agents were detected. Install one below, then click Rescan.
pageDescription: Discover installed agents, install new ones, and manage their profiles.
probingCapabilities: Probing agent capabilities… this usually takes a few seconds.
profileInUseIntro: This profile is currently in use. Deleting it will affect the following:
profileNameRequiredDescription: Please enter a profile name before saving.
promptTokenHint: <0>{{token}}</0> will be replaced with your task description or follow-up message.
reviewUpdateBeforeApplying: Review the update before Kandev changes this host runtime.
runtimeUpdateExplainer: This updates the managed runtime on this Kandev host, then refreshes its models and capabilities.
runtimeUpdateSessionsNote: Active sessions keep running; only later probes and launches use the refreshed runtime.
runtimeUpdatedRefreshFailed: Runtime updated, but capabilities could not be refreshed: {{error}}
runtimeUpdateStatusUnknown: Latest version for {{name}} is unavailable. The update control remains usable.
tuiCommandHelp: Binary name looked up on PATH. Use <0>{{token}}</0> to insert the model value.
tuiModelHelp: Profile label shown in the agent selector dropdown
duplicateSaveBlocked: Settings are still saving. Try again in a moment.
dynamicAgentsDescription: Route one logical profile through an ordered list of concrete agent profiles.
dynamicProfileDescription: Choose an ordered list of concrete profiles for fallback execution.
dynamicCandidatesDescription: Candidates run in order. The next candidate is used only when the configured error action allows it.
dynamicRoutingPolicySwitchable: Switching can follow classified provider failures: authentication or subscription problems, missing credentials or configuration, quota or rate limits, unavailable models, capacity, network, and provider availability or overload.
dynamicRoutingPolicyExcluded: Kandev does not switch for task, repository, permission, tool or runtime errors, transport loss, or ambiguous mid-turn results. Those cases stop for manual recovery to avoid repeating work.
dynamicRoutingPolicyRecovery: After a switch, the failed provider is paused for 1 minute, or until its reset time when provided. Kandev then runs an exclusive health probe before using it again.
dynamicPolicyWaitExplanation: Reset waiting uses a trusted future reset time once per candidate and error class, only when it is within your maximum. After that wait, Kandev makes one new attempt before applying the retry policy.
dynamicTransientErrorsDescription: Temporary conditions such as capacity, rate limits, network failures, timeouts, provider outages, and transport interruptions.
dynamicHardErrorsDescription: Account or configuration conditions such as subscription limits, exhausted credits, authentication, missing credentials, unavailable models, or provider configuration.
dynamicPolicyValidation: Fix the highlighted policy values before saving.
dynamicPolicyInitialIntervalValidation: Enter an initial interval between 1 second and 1 hour.
dynamicPolicyMaxWaitValidation: Enter a reset wait between 1 second and 7 days.
dynamicPolicySchedule: Retry up to {{retries}} times. The first retry waits {{first}} seconds, then the interval doubles.
dynamicPolicyNoRetry: No same-candidate retries. Kandev applies the selected outcome immediately.
dynamicPolicyWaitDescription: Use a trusted future reset or retry date when it is within the maximum wait.
dynamicPolicyRetryHelp: Retries the same candidate with exponential backoff before the selected outcome.
dynamicPolicyWaitHelp: Waits for a trusted future provider reset or retry date. The wait is bounded and used once per candidate and class.
dynamicPolicyOutcomeHelp: Controls what Kandev does after reset waiting and all same-candidate retries are exhausted.
noDynamicCandidates: Add at least one concrete profile.
dynamicCandidatePickerDescription: Choose a concrete profile that is eligible for dynamic routing.
dynamicRouteRetryDescription: Retry the same candidate after a provider error. Use this when a temporary failure may clear.
dynamicRouteTryNextDescription: Skip this candidate for the current turn and continue with the next eligible profile.
dynamicRouteStopDescription: Stop routing after this candidate fails. The task waits for a manual recovery action.
